title: I created AIGamesLab.net - a gallery of ONLY AI-generated games where you can upload a demo (webGL) or video and received feedback.
author: JuanixVentures
selftext:
So I love coming here to checkout you guys games/demos. But I feel we need some sort of catalog to easily see what people are up to. So I created it.

The main purpose is to discover games people are making. And if developers want, they can upload a webGL demo of the game to play in-browser. You can ask the AI to generate it for you. You can also link your socials/steam/sale pages where people can purchase it if your game is for sale already.

To make things even easier, there is an [MCP and SKILLs](https://aigamelabs.net/docs?section=quick-start&shell=bash) you can setup in your agent/harness that will teach/onboard to automatically publish the game in the site once its finished.

I'm looking forward to seeing all your games.
